verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents its own first-party `omarchy` CLI on a dedicated manual page. The manual says the CLI can control the system and is "particularly helpful when you're having an AI agent work with you on customization or configuration," and gives concrete subcommands such as `omarchy reminder` and `omarchy windows key`. Missing for 10: a full command reference or agent-oriented output details in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use by agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: you can also control it through the `omarchy` CLI. This is particularly helpful when you're having an AI agent work with you on customization or configuration.
You can also use the cli with `omarchy reminder 7 'Tea ready'`.
Run `omarchy windows key` to retrieve your machine's original key
